newsitem.title: USA: IBM to launch new data-storage products - NYT.
newsitem.headline: IBM to launch new data-storage products - NYT.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp plans to introduce a new line of data-storage products, the New York Times said.
In Monday's edition, the Times said IBM plans to begin shipping the new line until the end of this year and sometime in 1998.
The new design is being called Seascape. It is supposed to allow different types of computers using different operating system software to have access to data from a single source.
IBM is expected to discuss the new product with 60 analysts later today at the headquarters of its storage division in San Jose, Calif., the Times said.
